Messages.Author: Mirko Marinkovic
Messages.Body:
Hi all,
If vampire A has Enkil Cog, and he has 0 blood and is untapped, can he
take non-mandatory action(ie. equip) during other players turn or he
must hunt?
Thank You

Messages.Author: Vincent
Messages.Body:


He can't take another action.
He may hunt, but is not obliged to during other players turn.

From rulebook sec. 6 :
"A minion with a mandatory action to perform cannot perform any other
action."

Messages.Body:
